overview: Sharks in the warm seas. They leave you alone until you hit one or come near its pup.

1.0.0: Sharks in the warm and temperate oceans, on top of the dolphins already there.
A shark leaves you alone unless you hit it or come near its pup.
Sharks hunt fish, squid and small animals in the water, and eat what they catch.
A shark breathes water, and gives no Dolphin's Grace.
A Shark Spawn Egg, with the other spawn eggs.
Without Pandorical on your client, sharks look like dolphins.
With Minedew Fishing, a shark can take your bait in the ocean.
A small or medium shark is landed as whitefish fillets.
A large one comes up out of the water alive, and you have to fight it.
